{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line);
 border-radius:999px;background:rgba(8,10,20,.64);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.legend .r::before,.legend .l::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:5px}
.legend .r::before{background:var(--right);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--right)}
.legend .l::before{background:var(--left);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--left)}
#progressCard{position:absolute;right:10px;top:10px;min-width:210px;max-width:42vw;padding:8px 10px;
 border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;background:rgba(8,10,22,.66);
 backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);pointer-events:auto}
.progress-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
#timeline{width:100%;accent-color:#8d75ff}
#timeText{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--text);font-weight:750}
#keyboardShell{height:var(--keyboard-h);min-height:var(--keyboard-h);position:relative;
 background:#0c0e18;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);z-index:10;padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}
.keyboard-toolbar{height:32px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;
 padding:0 8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.keyboard-toolbar .left-tools{justify-self:start}.keyboard-toolbar .right-tools{justify-self:end}
.keyboard-toolbar button{min-height:26px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);
 color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:3px 8px}
#viewLabel{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800}
#keyboard{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:32px;bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom);overflow:hidden}
.key{position:absolute;top:0;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;transform-origin:top center;transition:
 background .07s ease,box-shadow .07s ease,transform .07s ease,filter .07s ease}
.key.white{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#edf0fa 68%,#d8ddea);
 border-right:1px solid #9fa7bd;border-bottom:1px solid #929bb2;border-radius:0 0 6px 6px;z-index:1}
.key.black{height:62%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#20243a,#080a12 76%,#010205);
 border:1px solid #000;border-radius:0 0 6px 6px;z-index:3;box-shadow:0 7px 11px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.key.pressed{transform:translateY(3px);filter:brightness(1.12)}
.key.white.active-r{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffd4e9,#ff75b8 70%,#e13a8a);box-shadow:inset 0 0 28px rgba(255,255,255,.65),0 -5px 22px rgba(255,79,163,.55)}
.key.black.active-r{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ff8ec5,#d2267b);box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(255,79,163,.8)}
.key.white.active-l{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#d9f8ff,#62dcfa 70%,#20a9cf);box-shadow:inset 0 0 28px rgba(255,255,255,.65),0 -5px 22px rgba(54,215,255,.55)}
.key.black.active-l{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7ee8ff,#128bad);box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(54,215,255,.8)}
.key.target{animation:targetPulse .85s
